scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class
other_conditions: The student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
The student must be studying in Andhra Pradesh
The parents/guardians must reside in Andhra Pradesh
Orphan, differently‑abled (physically handicapped) or children of single parents are given priority
The student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
The student must not have received any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose, except those benefiting from the Archaka Welfare Trust
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹7,000 per student for classes 6th to 10th.
